note: Measured from saved checkpoints by pipeline/tools/rank_saved.py; no retraining, no test split.

protocol.timing_scope: device-resident one-view forward with normalisation and softmax, trained weights; warmed, median of 100 passes after 20
protocol.limitations: Latency is the network forward only, not end-to-end serving. One timed process per graph, so repeated-process spread is not measured. Seeds of one arm share their graph timing. Accuracy is one checkpoint, so differences below the run-to-run floor of about 0.2 points are not resolved.
